name: voklance
description: Voklance professional networking and communities application

scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
